lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: Hey Nyagoa, where are you going?
lines.nuer: Ɣëy Nyagɔaa, Ji̱n wi̱i̱ ni̱kä?

lines.speaker: Nyagɔa
lines.english: I am going to the department store. I want to buy a toy and some candy.
lines.nuer: Ɣän wa̱a̱ kä thuk ko̱kä. Ɣän göörä kök kɛ duŋ ŋarä kɛnɛ alawani̱.

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: How much money do you have?
lines.nuer: Ji̱n ti̱i̱ kɛ yio̱w da̱ŋ di̱?

lines.speaker: Nyagɔa
lines.english: I have 10 dollars.
lines.nuer: Ɣän ta̱a̱ kɛ yio̱w da̱ŋ wäl.

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: Are you going to buy a lot of candy?
lines.nuer: Wä kɔkni̱ ji̱n kɛ alawani̱ ti̱ ŋuan?

lines.speaker: Nyagɔa
lines.english: Yes, I am. I want to share my candy with you.
lines.nuer: Ɣää, wa̱a̱ kɔk. Ɣän göörä bä alawani̱ nyuak kɛ ji̱ kɛɛl.

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: I like you, Nyagoa. You are nice.
lines.nuer: Ɣän nhɔakä nyinku Nyagɔaa. Ɛ ji̱n ram mi̱ gɔaa.

lines.speaker: Ba̱ba̱
lines.english: What’s wrong, Jay?
lines.nuer: Ɛ ŋu la riɛk ɔ?

lines.speaker: Taŋ
lines.english: I feel sick. Ugghh...
lines.nuer: Mocɛ ɣä jue̱y. ääɣɣ...

lines.speaker: Ba̱ba̱
lines.english: That’s too bad.
lines.nuer: Kä ɛn nɔmɔ ɛ mi jiääk ɛlɔ̱ŋ.

lines.speaker: Taŋ
lines.english: I want to go to the drugstore. I want to buy medicine. I want to go right now.
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä wä gua̱a̱th wal. Ɣän göörä kök kɛ wäl. Ɣän göörä wä ɛn tämɛ.

lines.speaker: Ba̱ba̱
lines.english: Do you want me to go with you?
lines.nuer: Ji̱n go̱o̱ri̱ ɣöö wä kɛɛl kɛ ji̱?

lines.speaker: Taŋ
lines.english: Yes, please!
lines.nuer: Ɣää, kua̱ läŋ ni̱ ji̱!

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.english: Hey Jock, what is your favorite sport?
lines.nuer: Ɣëy Jɔk, ɛ ŋar ŋukä nhɔk lɔcdɛ jɛ ɛlɔ̱ŋ ɔ?

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: My favorite sport is tennis. What is your favorite sport?
lines.nuer: Ŋarä min nhɔakä ɛ tɛnith. Ɛ ŋar ŋukä nhɔk lɔcdu jɛ ɔ?

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.english: I like to play baseball, but I like tennis, too! Who do you play with?
lines.nuer: Ɣän nhɔk lɔcdä ŋar kɛ yɔ̱ɔ̱l, dundɛ ɣöö nhɔakä tɛnith, bäni̱! Ɛ ŋa la ŋarɛ kɛɛl ɔ?

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: I play with my father. He’s a good tennis player.
lines.nuer: La ŋarä kɛɛl kɛ gua̱a̱r. Jɛn ɛ ŋäär tɛnithä mi gɔaa.

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.english: How often do you play?
lines.nuer: La yiɛn ɛ ŋar ni̱kä di̱?

lines.speaker: Jɔk
lines.english: We play every weekend. Do you want to play with us?
lines.nuer: La nɛy ɛ ŋar ni̱ni̱ lɔ̱ŋä diaal. Ji̱n go̱o̱ri̱ ŋar kɛ kɔ kɛɛl?

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.english: Okay!
lines.nuer: Ɣɔ̱ɔ̱!

lines.speaker: Duɔ̱ɔ̱p
lines.english: What do you want to do this weekend?
lines.nuer: Ɛ ŋu go̱o̱ri̱ bi lɛl kɛ ni̱n lɔ̱ŋä ti̱ti̱?

lines.speaker: Ja̱ny
lines.english: I want to go to the mountains.
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä wä päämni̱.

lines.speaker: Duɔ̱ɔ̱p
lines.english: Why do you want to go there?
lines.nuer: Ɛ ŋu go̱o̱ri̱ wä ɛn thɔ̱ŋ ɔ?

lines.speaker: Ja̱ny
lines.english: I want to go camping! I want to sleep outside in a tent.
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä wä ja̱l dɔɔr! Ɣän göörä tɔ̱ɔ̱c raar rɛy kɛmɛkä.

lines.speaker: Duɔ̱ɔ̱p
lines.english: That sounds like fun! I want to go camping, too! Can I go with you?
lines.nuer: Ce̱t lieŋdɛ kɛ mi dëë nhɔk! Ɣän göörä wä ja̱l dɔɔr, bäni̱! Ɣän /cä dee wä kɛɛl kɛ ji̱?

lines.speaker: Ja̱ny
lines.english: You will have to ask your parents first.
lines.nuer: Bi̱ diëëthku kɔn thiec kɛ nhiam.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.english: What are you doing, Nyanene?
lines.nuer: Ɛ ŋu lɛli̱ mɔ, Nyanɛnɛ?

lines.speaker: Nyanɛnɛ
lines.english: I am counting money.
lines.nuer: Ɣän kuɛ̈nä ni yio̱o̱wkä.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.english: How much do you have?
lines.nuer: Ti̱i̱ kɛ yio̱w da̱ŋ di̱?

lines.speaker: Nyanɛnɛ
lines.english: I have 14 dollars. I don’t have enough to buy a new video game.
lines.nuer: Ɣän ta̱a̱ kɛ yio̱w da̱ŋ wäl ŋuaan. Ɣän /cä tekɛ yio̱w ti̱ ro̱ŋ ti kɔakɛ vi̱diö gëëm.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.english: How much do you need?
lines.nuer: Ji̱n go̱o̱ri̱ yio̱w da̱ŋ di̱?

lines.speaker: Nyanɛnɛ
lines.english: I need to save 5 more dollars to buy the video game.
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä ɣöö bä yio̱w da̱ŋ dhieec ti̱ kɔ̱kiɛn dol kɛ ɣöö bä kɔk kɛ video game.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.english: Are you sure you want to spend all of your money?
lines.nuer: Ɛ thuɔ̱k i̱ go̱o̱ri̱ bi̱ yio̱wku diaal kɔak?

lines.speaker: Nyanɛnɛ
lines.english: I think it’s fun to spend money, don’t you?
lines.nuer: Ɣän carä jɛ, jɛn ɛ mi̱ tɛth lɔc nath ɛn kɔk yio̱wni̱, kä ji̱n /ciɛ car?

lines.speaker: Daaŋ
lines.english: What do you want to do today, Buay?
lines.nuer: Ɛ ŋu go̱o̱ri̱ i̱ bi lɛl ɛn walɛ, Buay?

lines.speaker: Buay
lines.english: I want to play baseball with my little brother. What do you want to do?
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä ŋar kɛ yɔ̱ɔ̱l kɛɛl kɛ dämaar. Ji̱n ɛ ŋu go̱o̱ri̱ i̱ bi lɛl?

lines.speaker: Daaŋ
lines.english: I want to play outside, but I can’t.
lines.nuer: Ɣän göörä ɣöö bä ŋar raar, dundɛ ɣöö /cä rɔ luäŋ?

lines.speaker: Buay
lines.english: Why not?
lines.nuer: Kɛ ɣöö i̱di̱?

lines.speaker: Daaŋ
lines.english: Because there is a big brown dog outside. I am afraid the big dog will bite me.
lines.nuer: Kɛ ɣöö tëkɛ ji̱o̱k mi lual mi di̱i̱t mi te raar. Ɣän dualä kɛ ɣöö jio̱k mi di̱i̱t bɛ ɣä ka̱c.
